bde.bookings.report_pdf @ admin.decision: BDE report sharing (Phase 5.2 P9, scope revised and approved 2026-11-02, design F.4 and E.1): the lead's owner BDE reads each report on their own leads as it prints, and downloads its current PDF. Both routes need accounts.view_own_lead_reports; ownership is enforced in the backend -- the lead, or the booking's lead, is looked up among the caller's own leads only -- so another BDE's lead, an unowned lead, the wrong type and a missing id all answer 404 NOT_FOUND, and an account that is not a BDE is answered NOT_A_BDE. Nothing records a send: report_shares and accounts.share_booking_report stay unused.

Both routes need accounts.view_own_lead_reports; ownership is enforced in the backend -- the lead, or the booking's lead, is looked up among the caller's own leads only -- so another BDE's lead, an unowned lead, the wrong type and a missing id all answer 404 NOT_FOUND, and an account that is not a BDE is answered NOT_A_BDE. Nothing records a send: report_shares and accounts.share_booking_report stay unused.

bookings.assign_tutor @ admin.decision: Booking management (Phase 2): /api/bookings/ serves holders of accounts.view_all_bookings (reading every booking and which tutors are free for its slot) and accounts.assign_booking_tutor (changing a booking's tutor), which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds both under D1). P6 (design E.1): a booking's rows and detail say whether it has its report and at which version, and whether one is due (has_report, report_version, report_due); the detail also names the report (report: id, version, when and by whom it was submitted, or null). BDE-to-PDF workflow Phase 1 (tutor permanent Google Meet link, scope approved 2026-11-03): one permanent Google Meet link per tutor (profiles.tutor_meet_link), created and changed only by team managers -- the Admin role, and superusers under D1 -- through PUT /api/team/<id>/meet-link/ (accounts.manage_team); each booking keeps its own copy (tutor_meet_link), shown to the Admin, the owner BDE and the tutor.
bookings.assign_tutor @ admin.note: An administrator assigns the booking's tutor (bookings.booking_service.assign_tutor). With P3 the booking in full also carries cancel_reason_code, the reschedule fields and links (rescheduled_at/by, reschedule_reason(_code), rescheduled_from, rescheduled_to) and the caller's actions. Fields added only: the same status, records and every earlier field. With Phase 1 the booking in full also carries tutor_meet_link: the booking's own copy of its tutor's Meet link, copied when the tutor is assigned (null here: tutor_a has none in this world). Field added only: the same status, records and every earlier field.
